leadText:
Amelia (Japanese: アメリア Amelia) is a character of the day who appeared in Master Class Choices!. She is a Pokémon Performer and is well-known among residents of her hometown, Fleurrh City. She comes from a wealthy family who also sponsor the local Pokémon Showcase.

Amelia entered the Fleurrh City Rookie Class Pokémon Showcase, hoping to win her third and final so she could compete for the title of in the Master Class tournament.

After gathering the highest number of during the Theme Performance, she was declared the winner of her group and advanced to the Freestyle Performance round. There, she delivered a performance along with her and , dazzling the crowd. However, when the audience was asked to vote for the act they appreciated the most, a majority voted for . As a result, Amelia lost the competition.

When she was leaving the Showcase theater, Amelia continued her snobbish behavior and demanded that former Kalos Queen Palermo, who had observed the day's Showcase, train her. In response, Palermo reminded her that she lost to Serena because the audience members had a different opinion. She told Palermo she wanted to surpass , and Palermo replied that complaining about the results of the Showcase isn't the best thing to do and added that it was up to Amelia to improve herself.
